task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

calls.candidate: hard Absence(key_lost), hard Existence(target_picked_up), hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key)
calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: two defects. (1) The hard Absence(key_lost) is not in the task: no sentence says anything about losing the key, so this clause adds a requirement the task never states and makes the natural key-first strategy (pick up key, drop it to free the hands, then move the ball) fail with -10. Remove it. (2) The wording 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' is the 'if a happens, b must also happen' pattern with 'also', which means the key may come before or after; the correct template is hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key), not Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key), which wrongly demands the key strictly after the ball is moved. Keep the hard Existence(target_picked_up), which covers 'Then pick up the box in the other room'.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) covers the unconditional 'pick up the box', and RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches 'if you move the ball, you must also take the key' (the 'also' wording allows before or after); the condition event blocker_moved correctly gets no Existence.
